intro: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise is a straightforward errand undertaken by young warriors and novices in the sun-baked Valley of Trials. Seeking relief from Durotar's punishing heat, the orc Galgar enlists travelers to gather wild cactus apples so he can prepare his famed refreshing treat. The task teaches fresh recruits how to forage and survive in an arid land.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.
If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, friend. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, friend! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
